content_sections.heading: About SCTIMST Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum is an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. The recruitment is conducted for a temporary ICMR funded research project based at the Bio Medical Technology Wing located in Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram. The appointment is initially for a period up to 13.09.2027, likely to be extended up to 13.09.2030.

content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the venue by 09.30 AM. Candidates reporting after 09.30 AM will NOT be considered for selection. Marks obtained in the written test, if conducted, will not be counted for final ranking.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Research Scientist II?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 04.11.2026 at 10.30 AM, with reporting time at 09.30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for SCTIMST Project Research Scientist II?
faq.answer: There is 1 existing vacancy reserved for ST candidates. In the absence of eligible ST candidates, SC candidates will be considered, and further in the absence of eligible SC candidates, UR candidates will be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary for the Project Research Scientist II post?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs.67,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, or Biological Sciences including Integrated PG Degrees, with 3 years of experience, OR a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test before the interview?
faq.answer: Depending on the number of candidates, a written test of a qualifying nature will be conducted for initial screening, and only qualified candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled Recruitment Report Form, bio-data, original and self-attested copies of age, qualification, and experience certificates, a valid caste certificate if applicable, and an NOC if currently in service.
